concept: Slides in a row that snap, with previous and next buttons and dots; it never moves by itself.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a carousel that auto-plays and loops with arrows overlaid on the slides
default_to_avoid.why_not: auto-play moves what the reader did not move and arrows over a photo fight the image; Pane waits and puts controls under it

derivation.consequence: nothing moves on its own; every motion answers something the reader did
derivation.form: nothing advances on its own; buttons, a swipe or a scroll move the slides

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the current dot is longer than the rest and in the loud solid, so where you are reads by shape

derivation.consequence: the loud action sits apart from secondary ones, never between them
derivation.form: the buttons and dots sit under the slides, apart from the content

variants.reason: A moves only when the reader moves it (P4) and keeps the photo clear. B moves by itself. C hides how many slides there are.

root.why: the slides and the controls stack and the wrapper measures its own width

track.why: the slides scroll and snap in one row and the row takes focus for the keyboard

v2.why: two slides show at once when the carousel is wide enough

v3.why: three slides show at once when the carousel is wide enough

slide.why: each slide snaps to the start of the row

controls.why: the buttons and dots sit centred under the slides

chev.why: the chevrons point back and forward and flip in RTL

dots.why: one dot per slide says how many there are

dot.why: a dot is a small round mark in the ring tone

on.why: the current dot is three times as long and in the loud solid, so where you are reads by shape

count.why: a hidden line announces which slide is shown after each move

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

focus-visible.why: the slide row shows the focus ring when reached by keyboard

inline-size.why: the current dot grows on the hover ease

background-color.why: the dot colour changes at the same pace as its length
